THE CONSTITUTION OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA
NOTIFICATION

IT is hereby notified that I have in the exercise of powers vested in me under paragraph (5) of Article 44 of the Constitutionof the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, determined that with effect from November 20, 2015, the assignmentof Duties and Functions, Departments, Statutory Institutions and Public Corporations to the State Minister of NationalPolicies and Economic Affairs appointed under paragraph (1) of Article 44, to be as indicated in the Schedule given below.
RANIL WICKREMESINGHE,Minister of National Policies andEconomic Affairs.
Colombo,16th November, 2015.
